My 2025 Spotify Favorites 🎧

My 2025 playlist is basically K-pop nostalgia + rap chaos + diva energy

January 30, 20252 min read

Music is probably the most accurate personality test I’ve ever taken, tho i am using gpt to generate this md blog In 2025, my Spotify basically said:

“She listens to everything… and she means EVERYTHING.”

So here are some of my absolute favorites this year — no skips, no shame.

🎶 1. K-pop Nostalgia Hits (aka my emotional damage section/i am already old man let me have some 2000 throwbacks)

Some songs are not just songs… they are entire eras.

  • DAY BY DAY — T-ARA
  • Cry Cry — T-ARA
  • Haru Haru — BIGBANG
  • FIRST LOVE (feat. EB) — T-ARA

If you know you know.

🎤 2. Rap / Hip-hop Narratives (main character energy)

When I want lyrics, storytelling, and dramatic beats:

  • luther (with SZA) — Kendrick Lamar
  • squabble up — Kendrick Lamar
  • Money Trees — Kendrick Lamar, Jay Rock
  • No Role Modelz — J. Cole
  • Pt. 2 — Kanye West
  • God’s Plan — Drake

Basically therapy but louder.

👑 3. Pop Divas & Chaos (Lady Gaga owns my soul, i LOVE Artpop!!!!)

This category is pure confidence and camp.

  • Government Hooker — Lady Gaga
  • Judas — Lady Gaga
  • Scheiße — Lady Gaga
  • Monster — Lady Gaga
  • Abracadabra — Lady Gaga
  • Applause — Lady Gaga

You want ICON music trust me.

💃 4. Dance / EDM Boosters (for hustling me ass to class)

  • Say My Name — David Guetta, Bebe Rexha
  • I’m Good (Blue) — Bebe Rexha
  • Ten More Days — Avicii
  • Rollin (feat. Future & Khalid) — Calvin Harris

These songs automatically increase my walking speed by 30%, said my apple watch.

🌙 5. Night Vibes & International Flavor (now the emo time you better be crying with me)

My playlist also travels across languages:

  • みずいろの雨 (Night Tempo Showa Groove Mix) — Junko Yagami
  • Dernière danse — Indila
  • Rosa (Que Linda Eres) — Trinix Remix
  • 如愿 — 王菲
  • 黑武士 — 林俊杰

Late-night headphones = different universe.

⭐ TL;DR: My Music Taste Makes No Sense (and I love that)

My 2025 Spotify favorites include:

  • K-pop nostalgia
  • Rap masterpieces
  • Pop diva chaos
  • EDM serotonin
  • Random global gems at 2AM

So yes…

I like Jazz but also Pop. Don’t judge me.
